title: Cargo
description: Physical shipment measure — the agreed mass and volume of the goods. Elective and NEVER default-on: composed only when an order moves physical goods. Density (mass ÷ volume) informs freight classification and handoff logistics; the declared NMFC class itself lives in the elective figaro-freight-class clause.

fields.name: massGrams
fields.description: Shipment mass in whole grams. Must be at least 1 g; capped at uint32 max (≈4.29 million kg).

fields.name: volumeMl
fields.description: Shipment volume in whole millilitres. Must be at least 1 ml; capped at uint32 max (≈4.29 million L).
